goal: Model modifies a parameterized mechanical part using numerical and actual visual evidence, and exports geometry meeting fixed requirements

stages.scope: bounded candidate execution and independent checker/render workers
typed tools, provenance, stale evidence rejection and ledger integration
actual view upload and image-aware model feedback through COW
Q4 authors plate Python and repairs against fixed requirements
110mm modification preserves mounting pattern and follows positive-X edge
90mm contradiction reported without silently changing requirements
kernel failures, worker timeouts, isolation, stale/mismatched exports and cancellation
matched-budget single attempt, independent candidates and sequential repair comparisons
simple directory CLI, static HTML evidence report, installation and end-to-end usage guide

boundaries.history: existing BW ledger and COW snapshots only
boundaries.authoring: ordinary model-written build123d Python and its inputs
boundaries.geometry: reopened STEP; no candidate constants or claimed pass flags
boundaries.views: actual same STEP SHA, explicit camera frame, CPU depth buffer
boundaries.kernel_independence: construction and checker share OpenCascade; not independent kernel verification
boundaries.isolation: candidate never receives protected checker or host home/credentials; bounded outputs and worker retirement required before model run

comparisons.budget: equal total inference budget for independent versus repair, including planning, vision criticism and selection
metrics: time and all inference to accepted artifact
